subtitle: Find enough power to face the Beast

body: inFAMOUS 2 is Sucker Punch Productions' PlayStation 3 action-adventure, released in North America on 7 June 2011. Cole MacGrath reaches New Marais after confronting a threat known as the Beast. He must develop his electrical powers before their next encounter, navigating a city inspired by New Orleans. Its streets, rooftops and waterways provide both routes and battlegrounds. The sequel continues Cole's story while giving his movement more room, making the journey across an urban district part of the pleasure of reaching the next mission.

Cole climbs buildings, crosses gaps and uses electrical infrastructure to move through the city. His powers support ranged attacks and close fighting, while the Amp adds a dedicated melee weapon. Electricity also supplies a resource to replenish, connecting combat to the objects and routes around him. Rather than remaining a backdrop, the city provides places to draw power and ways to approach an encounter from another height. Growing abilities change the ease of those movements, letting an increasingly powerful Cole cross spaces that once required a more cautious route.

Karma decisions again divide Cole's development between helpful and selfish uses of power. They affect available abilities, the response of people in the city and the direction of the story. The sequel also included tools for making and sharing user-created missions, extending the activities available within New Marais. Director Nate Fox returned, while the music drew on the sound of the city that inspired the setting. Its combination of traversal, combat and moral choices brought Cole's journey to two sharply different possible conclusions in the main campaign.
